summary: An incumbent declines a league debate and says they will take part in only one, run by the chamber of commerce.
realLife: A town's first selectman turned down the League of Women Voters' invitation for the second cycle running, saying the one debate would be the chamber's; the League's no-empty-chair rule canceled its event.
sources: Patch, league cancels first selectman debate (undated): https://patch.com/connecticut/monroe/monroe-lwv-cancels-first-selectman-debate-0
